register.name: Producer registers of the Department of Environment
register.notes: No single register brand — producers register with the Department of Environment and comply via a licensed collective system. Producers register regardless of volume. The state Department page (moa.gov.cy environment portal) returned HTTP 503 on 2026-08-16 and could not be fetched this session; Green Dot Cyprus (the licensed system) registration pages were fetched instead and are the practical registration/compliance route.

pro.ecoModulation: Aluminium (0.020 €/kg) far cheaper than other metal/tinplate (0.091); liquid cartons dearest at 0.117. Commercial/industrial packaging priced separately and lower (corrugated 0.041, plastic 0.036, wood 0.012 €/kg).

thresholds.deMinimis: No volume threshold — all producers must register (per Cyprus EPR guidance); the '2 t/year' figure previously noted from repax.io is not confirmed against the Packaging Law N32(I)/2002

notes: Green Dot Cyprus is the first and licensed packaging PRO (licensed 01.08.2006 under Packaging Law N32(I)/2002). Rates from its official approved fee table (fetched 2026-08-16), household packaging, €/t → €/kg: glass 27.61 → 0.028, carton/paper 44.78 → 0.045, metal/tinplate 90.62 → 0.091 (aluminium 20.31 → 0.020), PET & HDPE 100.60 → 0.101 ('plastic'), cardboard liquid containers 116.61 → 0.117 ('composite'). tariffYear 2025: the published table covers 2017–2025; a 2026 update was not yet public. Minimum fee €100/yr (0–1 t tier). Packaging Declarations 2026 due annually.
